The '''Harpori system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Harpori]].
